note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a quiet city street lined with low brick buildings, small shops and young trees
feature_en: a row of shop fronts with glass windows and small hanging signs
a young tree growing from a square cut in the pavement
ground_en: gray stone pavement with a thin line of paving seams
a smooth asphalt road with a faint painted crosswalk
far_en: the street running straight into the distance between brick buildings
a few parked bicycles and scooters along the curb

오후.sky_en: a pale blue sky with a few thin clouds above the rooftops

오후.shadow_en: short soft shadows fall on the pavement toward the camera's right
오후.desc_ko: 맑은 오후, 높은 해가 인물의 앞 왼쪽에서 비춤

camera.전신: Full-length shot from eye level with a 35mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head down to {p} feet on the pavement, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the street softly out of focus
camera.무릎 위: Medium-long shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just above the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the street softly out of focus
camera.허벅지 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to mid-thigh, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the street softly out of focus
camera.3/4 전신: Three-quarter shot from eye level with a 40mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just below the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the street softly out of focus
camera.가슴 위: Close portrait from eye level with a 70mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to mid-chest, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the street softly out of focus
camera.클로즈업: Close-up portrait from eye level with an 85mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} collarbones with {p} face filling about two thirds of the frame height, square frame, shallow depth of field with the street softly out of focus
